sentences.text: Ogni mattina volo con il parapendio.
sentences.text_en: Every morning I fly with a paraglider.

sentences.text: Il volo è in orario.
sentences.text_en: The flight is on time.

sentences.text: Se voli basso, eviti il vento.
sentences.text_en: If you fly low, you avoid the wind.

sentences.text: I voli notturni sono più economici.
sentences.text_en: Night flights are cheaper.

sentences.text: L'aquila vola sopra la valle.
sentences.text_en: The eagle flies above the valley.

sentences.text: In estate voliamo spesso all'alba.
sentences.text_en: In summer we often fly at dawn.

sentences.text: Quando volate, controllate il meteo.
sentences.text_en: When you (pl.) fly, check the weather.

sentences.text: Le volate in bici sono spettacolari.
sentences.text_en: The sprints in cycling are spectacular.

sentences.text: Le rondini volano in cerchio.
sentences.text_en: The swallows fly in circles.

sentences.text: Da ragazzo volavo spesso nei sogni.
sentences.text_en: As a boy I often flew in my dreams.

sentences.text: Mi dicevi che volavi senza paura.
sentences.text_en: You told me you used to fly without fear.

sentences.text: Il drone volava instabile.
sentences.text_en: The drone was flying unstably.

sentences.text: Durante il corso volavamo ogni weekend.
sentences.text_en: During the course we used to fly every weekend.

sentences.text: Ieri a quest'ora volavate sopra il mare.
sentences.text_en: At this time yesterday you (pl.) were flying over the sea.

sentences.text: Gli uccelli volavano bassi prima della pioggia.
sentences.text_en: The birds were flying low before the rain.

sentences.text: Quel giorno volai per la prima volta.
sentences.text_en: That day I flew for the first time.

sentences.text: Dopo l'esame volasti a Madrid.
sentences.text_en: After the exam you flew to Madrid.

sentences.text: Il gabbiano volò via.
sentences.text_en: The seagull flew away.

sentences.text: Con il club volammo fino alle Alpi.
sentences.text_en: With the club we flew as far as the Alps.

sentences.text: In primavera volaste spesso.
sentences.text_en: In spring you (pl.) flew often.

sentences.text: Appena aprì la gabbia, volarono via.
sentences.text_en: As soon as he opened the cage, they flew away.

sentences.text: Domani volerò a Cagliari.
sentences.text_en: Tomorrow I will fly to Cagliari.

sentences.text: Quando volerai, porta i documenti.
sentences.text_en: When you will fly, bring the documents.

sentences.text: Se il vento cala, il deltaplano volerà meglio.
sentences.text_en: If the wind drops, the hang glider will fly better.

sentences.text: A giugno voleremo di notte.
sentences.text_en: In June we will fly at night.

sentences.text: A che ora volerete domani?
sentences.text_en: At what time will you (pl.) fly tomorrow?

sentences.text: Con il caldo voleranno più in alto.
sentences.text_en: With the heat they will fly higher.

sentences.text: Se volassi, verrei da te.
sentences.text_en: If I flew, I would come to you.

sentences.text: Credevo che volassi più spesso.
sentences.text_en: I thought you flew more often.

sentences.text: Era impossibile che volasse con quel vento.
sentences.text_en: It was impossible that he/she flew with that wind.

sentences.text: Se volassimo presto, arriveremmo in tempo.
sentences.text_en: If we flew early, we would arrive on time.

sentences.text: Temevo che volaste di notte.
sentences.text_en: I feared that you (pl.) flew at night.

sentences.text: Desideravano che volassero sopra il lago.
sentences.text_en: They wished that they flew over the lake.

sentences.text: Con meno nuvole volerei volentieri.
sentences.text_en: With fewer clouds I would gladly fly.

sentences.text: Se potessi, voleresti ogni giorno.
sentences.text_en: If you could, you would fly every day.

sentences.text: Con un motore nuovo volerebbe meglio.
sentences.text_en: With a new engine it would fly better.

sentences.text: Con più ferie voleremmo a lungo.
sentences.text_en: With more vacation we would fly for longer.

sentences.text: Con quel budget volereste in economy.
sentences.text_en: With that budget you (pl.) would fly economy.

sentences.text: Con un invito volerebbero subito.
sentences.text_en: With an invitation they would fly immediately.

sentences.text: Vola alto ma resta prudente!
sentences.text_en: Fly high but stay careful!

sentences.text: Voli solo con istruttore.
sentences.text_en: Please fly only with an instructor.

sentences.text: Spero che tu voli con prudenza.
sentences.text_en: I hope that you fly carefully.

sentences.text: Voliamo all'alba!
sentences.text_en: Let's fly at dawn!

sentences.text: Benché voliamo, restiamo calmi.
sentences.text_en: Although we fly, we stay calm.

sentences.text: Volate in formazione!
sentences.text_en: Fly in formation!

sentences.text: Volino seguendo la rotta indicata.
sentences.text_en: Let them fly following the indicated route.

sentences.text: È bene che volino a vista.
sentences.text_en: It's good that they fly by sight.

sentences.text: Mi piace volare d'inverno.
sentences.text_en: I like to fly in winter.

sentences.text: Volando, notammo un temporale a ovest.
sentences.text_en: Flying, we noticed a storm to the west.

sentences.text: Ieri ho volato su un biplano.
sentences.text_en: Yesterday I flew on a biplane.

sentences.text: Prima di oggi avevo volato solo una volta.
sentences.text_en: Before today I had flown only once.

sentences.text: A fine mese avrò volato dieci ore.
sentences.text_en: By the end of the month I will have flown ten hours.

sentences.text: Non credo che abbia volato con noi.
sentences.text_en: I don't think he/she has flown with us.

sentences.text: Con meno turbolenza avrei volato ancora.
sentences.text_en: With less turbulence I would have flown more.

sentences.text: Palloncini volati via.
sentences.text_en: Balloons flown away.

sentences.text: Sabbiolina volata ovunque.
sentences.text_en: Fine sand flown everywhere.

sentences.text: Facciamo una volata al mare e torniamo.
sentences.text_en: Let's make a quick dash to the sea and come back.

sentences.text: Palloncini volati via dal giardino.
sentences.text_en: Balloons flown away from the garden.

sentences.text: Foglie volate sul terrazzo.
sentences.text_en: Leaves flown onto the terrace.

sentences.text: Le volate in pista sono emozionanti.
sentences.text_en: The sprints on the track are exciting.

sentences.text: Un drappo volante attraversò la scena.
sentences.text_en: A flying cloth crossed the scene.

sentences.text: La volante è intervenuta subito.
sentences.text_en: The police patrol car intervened immediately.

sentences.text: Il pipistrello è un volatore abilissimo.
sentences.text_en: The bat is a very skilled flyer.

sentences.text: Gli scoiattoli volatori planano tra gli alberi.
sentences.text_en: Flying squirrels glide among the trees.

sentences.text: È una volatrice esperta di alianti.
sentences.text_en: She is an expert glider pilot.

sentences.text: Le volatrici del club hanno gareggiato ieri.
sentences.text_en: The female flyers of the club competed yesterday.

sentences.text: Vedo gli studenti.
sentences.text_en: I see the students.

sentences.text: Io gli parlo adesso.
sentences.text_en: I am speaking to him now.

sentences.text: Io gli scrivo domani.
sentences.text_en: I will write to them tomorrow.
